response.limits: Blind read of two frontal PA chest X-rays with no indication and no dates. No lateral view, so the retrocardiac region and the lung behind the diaphragm are assessed on frontal projection only. The images are low resolution and compressed, which limits fine detail such as nodule margins, calcification and subtle rib lesions. No pixel scale is available, so no sizes are given. The radiologist should measure the marked findings in PACS. Breast shadows overlie both lower zones. This is a draft for resident and attending review.
